compression_level.description: Compression level from 0 (fastest) to 9 (slowest/best). Default is 6.

suffix.description: Suffix appended to compressed output files.

keep_source.description: If true, keep the original input files after processing. If false, delete them.

force_overwrite.description: If true, silently overwrite existing output files. If false, refuse to overwrite.

show_progress.description: If true, display percentage progress during compression.

files.description: List of file paths to compress or decompress.
